objective: Determine whether auxiliary supervision of unaddressed-register persistence alone (L_terminal + 0.5 * L_persist) is sufficient to induce canonical coordinate preservation and modular addition generalization in CyclicMGUPhase16Model, or whether intermediate destination supervision is causally necessary.
hypothesis: HYPOTHESIS (not a proven cause): persistence supervision alone provides sufficient inductive constraint to preserve r0 coordinates during the S1 -> S2 transition without requiring direct intermediate destination write losses.
scientific_distinction: The cyclic ALU is fixed and analytical. Any improvement or degradation in this ablation concerns the supervision of the learned read, write and gate networks around it; it is not evidence of learned arithmetic from data.

loss_definition.destination_loss: 0.5 * [CE(logits_dest_0, a) + CE(logits_dest_1, b)] (diagnostic telemetry only, excluded from training objective)
loss_definition.composite_reference_loss: terminal_loss + 1.0 * destination_loss + 0.5 * persistence_loss (diagnostic reference matching primary EXP-CYCLIC-PERSIST-01)

persistence_query_definition.state: S2 (post step-1 transition, instruction 'SET r1 b')
persistence_query_definition.register: r0 (unaddressed at step 1, written at step 0)
persistence_query_definition.readout: project(mlp_read([S2, e_r0])) using the existing shared mlp_read network
persistence_query_definition.target: a (the r0 value written at step 0)
persistence_query_definition.equivalence: u_persist_1 is computationally identical to the step-2 operand read u_a

target_definition.verification: matched Phase16RegisterTask.simulate_trace() on every allowed example

metric_definitions.c_read: mean of the per-role mean cosine(u_a, Phi(a)) and cosine(u_b, Phi(b)) at step 2
metric_definitions.s_context: unweighted mean over digits of the mean pairwise cosine similarity of same-integer step-2 operand reads pooled across roles and contexts
metric_definitions.c_alu: mean cosine of the raw cyclic_alu(u_a, u_b) tensor at step 2 with Phi((a+b)%10)
metric_definitions.c_dest: mean of the step-0/1/2 mean cosines of u_dest_post with Phi(y_destination_t)
metric_definitions.cosine_guard: denominator epsilon 1e-08; similarity 0.0 if either norm < 1e-07

protocol.checkpoint_selection: minimum validation total loss under native ablation objective, ties by highest validation accuracy, then earliest update

protected_test_split.status: STRICTLY FIREWALLED — never loaded, constructed, evaluated, queried or logged

gate_assessment.description: Inconclusive: Intermediate behavioral accuracy (4..15/16) and partial representation alignment (0.30 <= C < 0.80); sub-threshold on both dimensions.
